annotations.text:
The number that reconciles is POINTS BANKED, not season points.
S&F total = per gameweek, starters x multiplier + auto-subs on. Bench points are never banked.
So every player splits into: started / armband on top / came on as a sub — and, outside the total, what they scored while benched.
A — smallest change. Same pitch, same tap. Chip number becomes what the player banked; the micro-bar under it shows the split. Cost: the split is tiny at 46px wide.
B — answers your question directly and adds up in front of you. Sortable by armband or sub. Cost: a table is not a pitch; the squad shape is gone unless you flip back.
C — shows WHERE, not just how much: the six weeks the armband paid, the weeks a sub rescued, the red dashed cells you never banked. Cost: densest, needs sideways scroll on a phone.
